items.author: karadoc.aus.social.ap.brid.gy
items.context:
I own a bunch of DOS games from GOG. Unfortunately, all of these are bundled with a Windows version of DOSBox only. I'd like to use a linux version. But which one? Apparently there are two 'modern' versions of DOSBox; called "DOSBox-x" and "DOSBox Staging". I'm wondering if anyone has any […]
link card: Original post on aus.social
items.text: From what I know, DOSBox Staging is the leaner, modern pick for just playing DOS games, while DOSBox-X goes further with extras like Windows 9x and PC-98 support. For a library of GOG DOS games, Staging is usually the simpler start.
items.verify: Проверить: DOSBox Staging проще для обычных DOS-игр, DOSBox-X шире по возможностям (Win9x, PC-98).
